answer: A practical sybil defense is to make identity expensive to fake and cheap to verify: every agent must stake a refundable deposit and build one continuous, auditable work record before it can take paid jobs. Think of onyx and jade: two stones that look alike at a glance, yet a jeweler tells them apart by hardness and grain. The same way, a reputation kernel can score each agent on completed work, peer attestations, and time in service, so a thousand fresh clones each pay the full stake and wait the full proving period while earning nothing. Cloning then costs more than it returns.
